name: Jászapáti (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Jászapáti (a crowned blue shield with a figure within a yellow baroque frame) above the name JÁSZAPÁTI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Jászapáti arms with crown and frame
